use_case_summary: Striato Quantia operates real-time market signal scoring and candidate reranking for algorithmic trading. Primary constraints: deterministic latency (p95/p99), predictable throughput for black-box trading windows, and strict EU/US data residency plus audit trails. Cost sensitivity high due to sub-millisecond scale of trade decisioning; looking to reduce per-request token cost via batching/caching and int8 quantization while keeping tail latency under SLA.
notes:

- Problem: current LLM-based reranker spikes tail latency during market opens; want stable 99th percentile. Cost per request also high on full fp16 models.

- POC plan: 2-week on-prem POC with Redwood Private in our lab (GPU access), Redwood to run perf harness and deliver a perf report + quantization recommendation. Need dedicated SE (Priya) to run config tuning (batching thresholds, cache TTLs, kernel selection).
